title: Signal and Vector Again
author: Ulyana Halloran
blurb: Felix Sterling, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
